description: Primary source code for the Flutter frontend of a notes management application. Includes service classes for API interactions, data models, state management, UI components, and application entry point.

classes.name: NotesApiService
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests to fetch, search, create, update, and delete notes from the backend API.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a single note with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class using ChangeNotifier to handle notes list, search, and CRUD operations with API.

classes.name: MyNotesApp
classes.description: Root widget that initializes theme, loads environment variables, and sets up providers.

classes.name: NotesHomePage
classes.description: Main page displaying list of notes, search bar, and modal dialog triggers for create/edit.

classes.name: NoteCard
classes.description: UI component that displays individual note information with options to edit or delete.

classes.name: NoteEditorDialog
classes.description: Modal dialog for creating or editing a note, with form validation and submission handling.

classes.name: RoundedSearchField
classes.description: Custom widget for a stylized search input field.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the server.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Performs a search query on notes from the server.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the server.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note on the server.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note on the server.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Note instance from JSON data.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Reloads notes, either fetching all or performing a search based on current query.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the current search query and refreshes notes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, loads environment, and runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for various widgets defining their UI layout and theme.

methods.name: _onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating notes.
